description: Search Nomid's public website (www.nomidmdm.com) for plans and pricing: the Free, Pro and Enterprise plans and their device limits, list prices per Android and VR device per month in USD, EUR and BRL, the annual discount, what each plan includes (e.g. remote access and the API are paid), and the pricing FAQ (payment methods, plan changes, pilots, custom plans). Returns excerpts with their page URL to cite. These are public list prices, not this company's own contract or invoice. For how to use a product feature, use the documentation search instead.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

locale.description: The language to answer in: en, es or pt (Brazil). Defaults to en.

query.description: What to look up, in the user's words, e.g. "Pro price per VR device", "does Free include remote access", "payment methods".

name: search_nomid_site
title: Search the Nomid website
